live.offline: Offline: reload to see the latest

list.countMore_one: {count} work order shown, more to load
list.countMore_other: {count} work orders shown, more to load

noMatch.title: No work orders match
noMatch.body: Change the search or the rows shown.

empty.title: No work orders yet
empty.body: A work order is made from the open lines of a confirmed sales order.
empty.bodyView: Work orders appear here once the planner makes them.

bulk.releaseHeld_one: {count} selected is not a draft: only drafts are released
bulk.releaseHeld_other: {count} selected are not drafts: only drafts are released
bulk.releaseBody: Each work order is checked again as it is released: the spec is frozen and a batch number given. One the check holds stays a draft, with what holds it.

held.noManage: You can view work orders, not change them (workorders.manage)
held.noRelease: Releasing needs the right to release (workorders.release)
held.checksOpen_one: {count} check holds the release: see Overview
held.checksOpen_other: {count} checks hold the release: see Overview
held.finished: A closed or cancelled work order keeps its details

new.title: New work order
new.orderHint: Confirmed orders not shipped yet, by number or customer reference.
new.noOrders: Finding a sales order needs orders.view: ask an administrator.
new.nothingOpen: Every line of this order is already on work orders.
new.mtmLater: Made-to-measure: comes in a later step
new.lineFull: Nothing open: already on work orders
new.over: At most {open}: the rest is on other work orders
new.dueHint: Empty: the earliest promise of the lines.

held.lines: Pick at least one order line
held.over: A size asks more than is open on its line

record.title: Work order

not_found.title: This work order does not exist
not_found.body: It may be in another company, or the link is wrong.

forbidden.title: You may not see this work order
forbidden.body: Work orders need workorders.view for their company and site: ask an administrator.

record.dockHint: Notes and files beside every tab (⌘J)
record.noPanels: The thread opens with the work order.
record.changed: Someone changed this work order at {time}
record.closed: Closed: nothing changes any more but its note.
record.readOnly: You can view this work order, not change it.

notReleased.title: Not released yet
notReleased.body: {what} once the work order is released.

overview.overrideHint: Only material is short: the planner may release with a reason (the floor then waits for the stock).
overview.notFrozen: Not frozen yet: the release freezes the revision, the operations and the planned materials.
overview.batchHint: Given at the release; it never changes.
overview.label: Garment label
overview.frozenHint: A different spec is a new work order (a change request comes later).
overview.priorityHint: A whole number from -1000 to 1000; higher comes first.

REVISION.OK: Rev {revision} is released; the release freezes it.
REVISION.none: No released revision of the style is chosen.
REVISION.notReleased: Rev {revision} is not released: a work order is released only with a released revision.

LABEL_TEMPLATE.none: The revision names no garment label: set one in Compliance › Labels & marking.
LABEL_TEMPLATE.notActive: Garment label {label} is not active: the release needs it active.

CERTIFICATE.OK: A valid certificate covers every colourway and size today.
CERTIFICATE.NOT_REQUIRED: No certificate is needed for this style.
CERTIFICATE.BLOCKED: No valid certificate covers every size today (Reg. (EU) 2016/425).

WORK_CENTRES.OK: Every operation has an active work centre at {site}.
WORK_CENTRES.BLOCKED: Site {site} lacks a work centre for some operations.
WORK_CENTRES.noSteps: The routing has no operation the floor could scan (no released revision with a routing).

check.noRevision: Follows the style revision: choose a released one first.

BOM.OK: The BOM covers every size and colourway.
BOM.BLOCKED: The BOM does not cover every size and colourway: a new revision is needed.

CELLS.BLOCKED: Some sizes are not in the style any more.

DEPOSIT.OK: Every order's deposit is paid or waived.
DEPOSIT.BLOCKED: An order waits for its deposit: production starts when it is paid or waived.

MATERIAL.OK: Usable stock at the site covers every material.
MATERIAL.BLOCKED: Material is short at the site: wait for stock, or release with the planner’s reason.
MATERIAL.OVERRIDDEN: Material short, released by the planner’s reason.

BATCH_NUMBER.OK: A batch number is given at the release and never changes.
BATCH_NUMBER.BLOCKED: The company has no batch number series: an administrator sets one up in Admin › Documents & numbering.

problem.certificate: {cell}: no valid certificate covers it today
problem.bom: {cell}: the BOM does not cover it
problem.size: {cell}: the size is not in the style any more

reason.CR_VI_PENDING: waits for its Cr VI result

size.title: Size run
size.uncounted: Nothing counted for this yet: the floor reports it as the work goes on.
size.editHint: At most what is still open on each order line; 0 takes a size off.
size.draftHint: A draft: its sizes change until it is released.
size.frozenHint: Frozen at release. Counts come from the floor: cut from the cutting log, in bundles from the bundles, sewn and finished from the scans.

copy.caption: Pieces by colourway and size
copy.cutToMax: {cell}: at most {max} pieces in one cell.

materials.wouldFreeze: What the release would freeze now, waste included
materials.noPick: The pick list (stock per lot and hide) needs inventory.issue.
materials.pickAfterRelease: The pick list opens once the work order is released: the floor issues by scan.
materials.usable_one: Usable at the site: {quantity} {uom} in {count} lot or hide
materials.usable_other: Usable at the site: {quantity} {uom} in {count} lots or hides

cutting.what: The cutting log per hide starts
cutting.planHint: A garment counts as cut when every part cut from hides is cut.
cutting.logHint: Append-only: a correction adds a mirror entry, the original stays.

hold.usedUp: The hide is used up: only its closing cut can be corrected
hold.notOpen: The work order is not in production
hold.reversal: A correction is not corrected again

cutting.closingHint: The last cut of a used-up hide: correcting it opens the hide again.
cutting.correctionOf: This entry corrects the cut of {when}; the reason is in the history.

correct.title: Correct the cut of {hide}
correct.body: A mirror entry takes back {pieces} pieces and {area} of area; the original entry stays in the log.
correct.closing: This is the closing cut of a used-up hide: correcting it opens the hide again.
correct.bundles: A cut that bundles were made from is corrected only after those bundles are voided.
correct.reasonHint: 3 to 500 characters; kept with the entry.
correct.reasonShort: Say why in at least 3 characters

bundles.what: Bundles are made at the cutting table
bundles.cellsHint: Whole garments; a part bundle counts its pieces apart.
bundles.empty: No bundles yet: they are made at the cutting table.
bundles.emptyFilter: No bundle waits at this operation.

hold.void: A void bundle has no ticket to reprint
hold.notOpen: The work order is not in production

reprint.body: Each bundle gets a new code; scanning the old ticket then says it was replaced. The reason stays with the bundle.
reprint.noPrinter: This site has no active label printer: tickets are reprinted at the floor tablet.

ops.plannedHint: Each routing step at a work centre of the site; frozen at the release.
ops.readyToComplete: Every garment is finished: complete the work order.
ops.title: Operations and work in progress
ops.hint: From the floor’s scans of active bundles; never per person or per station.
ops.noLines: No finished garments reported on a line yet.
ops.linesHint: Output per line only (the line of the reporting station).
ops.correctionsWaiting_one: {count} correction request waits for a decision.
ops.correctionsWaiting_other: {count} correction requests wait for a decision.
ops.correctionsHint: The original scan stays; an approved correction adds a row.

quality.hint: Released garments may be shipped. Inspecting and releasing are done in Quality and at the inspection bench.

release.title: Release {number}
release.body: The spec is frozen at Rev {revision}; a batch number is given and never changes; the floor can start.
release.reversal: Taking it back: cancel it with a reason; a different spec is a new work order.
release.short: Material is short at the site.
release.override: Release with the material short (planner’s override)
release.overrideNeeded: Material is short: tick the override and say why
release.reasonHint: 3 to 500 characters; kept with the release.
release.refused_one: The release check holds it: {count} check changed since the page read it. See Overview.
release.refused_other: The release check holds it: {count} checks changed since the page read it. See Overview.

start.title: Start {number}
start.body: Marks the work order in progress now. The floor’s first cut, issue or scan starts it by itself: start it by hand only when work began without one.

complete.title: Complete {number}
complete.body: Every garment is finished at the final operation. Completing ends the floor’s scans on it; inspection, labels and release go on.

close.title: Close {number}
close.body: A closed work order is final: only its note changes after.

cancel.title: Cancel {number}
cancel.bodyDraft: The draft stops; its pieces go back to the order lines.
cancel.bodyStarted: The work order stops; its pieces go back to the order lines. What was issued or cut stays with it until it is returned by hand.

notice.corrected: Corrected: a mirror entry is in the log.

error.read: Nexus Factory didn't answer as expected: try again.
error.offline: No connection to Nexus Factory: try again in a moment.
error.forbidden: You may not do this here: ask an administrator for the right.
error.changed: Someone changed this work order meanwhile: it was read again, look and try again.
error.conflict: It changed meanwhile: it was read again, look and try again.
error.gone: It is not there any more.
error.invalid: Nexus Factory refused it as it is: check the values.
error.printer: The printer refused it: choose another label printer.
error.write: It didn't go through: try again.

refusal.other: The rules of the floor refuse it now.

cut.WORK_ORDER_NOT_OPEN: The work order is not in production any more.
cut.HIDE_USED_UP: The hide is used up: only its closing cut can be corrected.
cut.NOT_A_CUT: A correction is not corrected again.
cut.IN_BUNDLE: Bundles were made from this cut: void them first, then correct it.

bundle.WORK_ORDER_NOT_OPEN: The work order is not in production any more.
bundle.FLOOR_NOT_READY: The floor of this site is not ready yet (privacy notice, floor rules).

floor.privacy: Totals per work order, operation and line only (Statuto dei Lavoratori art. 4).
floor.wipHint: Pieces waiting · done at each operation; an operation opens its bundles.

empty.title: Nothing on the floor right now
empty.body: A released work order shows here once the floor starts on it.

floor.opLink: {seq} {code}: {waiting} waiting, {good} done — open the bundles waiting here
